campaign.name: Beat the surface code at k=10, weight-4, 2D single-layer

direction.hypothesis: A weight-4 2D-local code at k~10 can beat the surface-code baseline (10 independent d=5 patches, n~250) on kd^2/n while keeping locality honest.

bar.note: Dense-packed surface [[101,5,5]] as structural reference; 10 logicals ~ 2 patches.

direction.feasibility: Weight-4 2D-local cell already populated; board_bar.py can price candidates before distance search.

novelty.claim: First systematic k~10 frontier probe in this cell
novelty.against: Existing local-2d-single weight-4 entries and surface-code patches.

direction.expected_value: A weight-4 2D-local code at k>=8 on the cell frontier would be the first multi-logical result in this cell.

abandon_criterion.note: Drop the ladder if two consecutive rungs agree below the bar.

direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: Whether weight-4 2D-local constructions can reach k~10 at all, or whether the cell is structurally capped below that.
